tagline: Where every move tells a story.
description: The Example Club brings together players of every skill level — from first-time pawns to seasoned tacticians. We meet weekly to play, study famous games, run friendly ladder tournaments, and prepare for regional scholastic competitions. No experience required; boards and coaching provided.
moreText: Ready to make your move? Drop by any Thursday meeting — no chess experience needed, just curiosity.

events.title: Fall Blitz Tournament
events.description: Fast-paced 5-minute games, open to all members. Prizes for the top three finishers.

events.title: Grandmaster Game Review Night
events.description: We break down a classic World Championship game move by move — bring a notebook.

events.title: Winter Simul with Local Master
events.description: A visiting master plays every club member simultaneously across 15 boards.

events.title: New Year Puzzle Rush
events.description: Timed tactics puzzles in teams of two — no board experience required to join in.

events.title: Regional Qualifier Prep Session
events.description: Focused opening prep and endgame drills ahead of the regional qualifiers.

events.title: Spring Championship
events.description: Our biggest event of the year — a full round-robin club championship.
